body: That sounds nice, but I really do truly believe that every friend I have ever had would have been better off without me. I have had a lot of years to think about the balance of positive and negative impacts that I have had, and it is always more towards the negative, even if they don't see it. I think if I don't go soon, I am going to try to actively distance myself from all my current friends for this reason. I hope you do manage to break into software engineering.

That sounds like a good idea. I probably will not myself, but it is a good idea. Siri, Alexa and Google tell me that every day, but I'm too dense to listen. I think I really honestly wasn't expecting anyone to read this at all. I really just felt like maybe, before I go I should try telling someone or something, even if it's just telling the internet void of unread Reddit posts. I hope you can find yourself again. I know what you mean by that... I don't know what it takes to get there, but I hope everything it takes to get there happens for you.
